title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-purchase activities at Lawrence University and nearby Appleton destinations, with public or student access stated for each.

cards.title: Catch an Ensemble Concert
cards.subtitle: Hear a Lawrence ensemble perform on campus
cards.notes: Check the Conservatory calendar for an ensemble concert, then meet at the listed venue early enough to choose seats together.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket outing built around live performances by Lawrence ensembles.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence University identifies non-ticketed ensemble concerts as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public when the event is listed as non-ticketed; confirm the date and venue on Lawrence's calendar.

cards.entity_name: Lawrence University Student and Faculty Recitals
cards.title: Drop In for a Recital
cards.subtitle: Share a focused hour of live music
cards.notes: Choose a student or faculty recital from the Conservatory calendar and use the program afterward to compare favorite pieces.
cards.short_summary: An intimate, public performance with no ticket or purchase required.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence University lists non-ticketed student and faculty recitals as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for non-ticketed recitals; verify the event listing because ticketed productions follow different rules.

cards.title: Watch a Dance Series Event
cards.subtitle: See movement, improvisation, or storytelling together
cards.notes: Pick an event explicitly marked free, note its campus studio, and arrive with time to find the correct room before it begins.
cards.short_summary: Free performances and workshops make a lively shared arts outing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence's Conservatory FAQ says non-ticketed Dance Series events are free and open to the public; the series page labels individual events free.
cards.access_notes: Use an event listing marked “Free admission” or “Free and open to the public”; special ticketed dance events are excluded.

cards.title: Try the New Music Series
cards.subtitle: Listen for unfamiliar sounds and ideas
cards.notes: Find a non-ticketed New Music Series date and invite friends to trade one observation each after the performance ends.
cards.short_summary: A free route into contemporary music without committing to a ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence University lists the non-ticketed New Music Series among events that are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public when non-ticketed; consult the current Conservatory calendar for a scheduled performance and venue.

cards.title: Meet Up at a Community Concert
cards.subtitle: Hear Lawrence musicians around Appleton
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled community concert, meet at its host location, and stay for the performer's short introduction to the music.
cards.short_summary: Public concerts pair live music with brief listening context.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence University states that its community concerts are always open to the public and free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; check the posted schedule because concerts rotate among named Appleton venues.

cards.entity_name: Lawrence University Lunar New Year Celebration
cards.title: Join the Lunar New Year Celebration
cards.subtitle: Gather for a family-friendly campus program
cards.notes: Watch the university events calendar for the annual celebration, then attend the multicultural activities and performances together.
cards.short_summary: An annual Lawrence gathering centered on cultural activities and performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence documents its annual, family-friendly Lunar New Year celebration as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the celebration is annual, so confirm the next date and campus location before going.

cards.entity_name: Seeley G. Mudd Library Group Study Floors
cards.title: Hold a Group Study Hang
cards.subtitle: Spread out together on Mudd Library's first or second floor
cards.notes: Bring a shared reading or project to the first-floor group area; choose the second floor when your group needs a quieter conversation.
cards.short_summary: Two designated group-study floors support free, collaborative time on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence identifies the first and second floors of Mudd Library as group-study floors and welcomes Fox Cities residents to use the library.
cards.access_notes: Lawrence students may use the study areas during building hours; community guests must arrange access through the guest form.

cards.entity_name: Seeley G. Mudd Library Quiet Study Floors
cards.title: Share a Quiet Work Session
cards.subtitle: Settle into Mudd Library's third or fourth floor
cards.notes: Agree on a work block before arriving, use the third floor for quiet study, or choose the fourth floor when everyone wants silence.
cards.short_summary: A structured, no-spend work session in Mudd's quietest spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence designates Mudd Library's third floor for quiet study and its fourth floor, including the Kruse Room, for silent study or reflection.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; Lawrence students have ordinary access, while community guests must submit the guest-access form.

cards.entity_name: Appleton Public Library Public Computers and Wi-Fi
cards.title: Plan Something on Library Wi-Fi
cards.subtitle: Use free internet and computers just west of campus
cards.notes: Meet at Appleton Public Library to plan a trip, build a playlist, or work online; bring photo ID if you need a computer guest pass.
cards.short_summary: A free digital planning session at the downtown public library.
cards.evidence_claim: Appleton Public Library provides free Wi-Fi and free computer use; visitors without cards can receive a guest pass by showing photo ID.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; computer use is limited to three hours daily and requires a library login or photo-ID guest pass.

cards.title: Learn a Tech Skill Together
cards.subtitle: Bring devices or questions to a free help session
cards.notes: Check the volunteer calendar, bring one concrete device or internet question, and call ahead to confirm the walk-in helper is available.
cards.short_summary: Free, person-to-person help for everyday technology questions.
cards.evidence_claim: Appleton Public Library states that it offers free one-on-one walk-in technology-help sessions.
cards.access_notes: Free walk-in help is offered at scheduled volunteer times; check the calendar and call ahead because a volunteer may cancel.
